title: Estrogen modulates reward prediction errors and reinforcement learning
goal: Recreate the original findings and separately exceed them on the same source-paper task: Estimate proestrus-versus-diestrus dopamine response differences and estradiol/RPE/reward-history associations.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable submitted analysis and source-native outputs for the complete original finding and companion panel.
Improvement: candidate outputs and a comparison on the same original task under improvement.v1.json.
Separate evidence for both outcomes under matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions.
success_criteria: Assess reproduction and improvement independently under reproduction.v1.json and improvement.v1.json; do not combine their scores.
Preserve the original task, full panel, permitted observations, metrics, aggregation and required companion controls.
Reproduction requires a source-grounded computation and independently verified granular outputs; copying published findings alone is insufficient.
Improvement requires the unchanged improvement contract's same-task comparison, uncertainty and admission rules.
Use outcomes.v1.json for the matched information conditions and budgets; a declared contract or admitted receipt is not scientific qualification.
Author-baseline replay remains calibration. Historical reconstruction attempts retain their original scope and are not promoted to new qualified AI reproduction results.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.assessment: Official EstrousRPEPaper README links three Zenodo records. Figure2 Pstruct/Bstruct also needs SerumTable fromFigure1; Figure3 loads RawData_Figure3.mat. Some behavioral parameters are supplied BestFits.

versions_and_loader_contract.input_code_bridge: The official README maps multiple Zenodo archives, not just Figure2. Source ProcessData_Figure2 loads Pstruct/Bstruct and requires SerumTable from RawData_Figure1; both archives are identified. Figure3 archive directory contains RawData_Figure3.mat; its loader reads ratTrial, Pstruct/Bstruct, times_resampled and stage labels. Full raw trial/photometry structures are documented, not only rendered panels.
versions_and_loader_contract.readiness_scope: Only the listed substantial empirical analyses are artifact-ready for an attempt. This is not whole-paper reproduction, environment qualification, or scientific validation.

improvement.action: The registered target is estrous/hormone modulation of dopamine and reward-history associations. The paper explicitly avoids calling the behavioral modulation better or worse because the optimized costs/benefits are unobserved. A greater dopamine contrast or smaller P value cannot surpass that finding; fitting a new predictor would change the task.
